content: Filator sarme Isa
Kub binna sore, ḍõr imam okkol edde murubbi okkol, edde alem okkol, ḍõr šobar beggune ek mošora goijje. Tarfore hitara Isare bandiyore loigiye edde Filator hatot gosaidiye.
Filate fusar goredde, "Tui ki Ihudi okkolor badša?" Isaye zuwabe hodde,
Ḍõr imam okkole hibar namot bout hosuri okkol diye.
Tarfore Filate Isattu abar fusar goijje, "Tui ki hono zuwab no dibi? Sa, hitara tore hodun hosuri der?"
Kintu Isaye ek ohor udda zuwab no de, henot Filat tajjuf oiye.
Fotti uddar idot Filate mainše zare saito hendilla ekzon bondire eridito.
He šomot Barabbas name ekzon manuš hokumotor ulda hórtal goroya okkolor fũwati ziyolot bondi aiššil, zara hórtalor butore ekzonore kun gorifelail.
Manuš okkole Filator hãse aiyore guzora šuru goijje, hite goittode hendilla goribolla.
Toi Filate hitarare hodde, "Tũwara so ne, ãi Ihudi okkolor badšare eridi?"
Dõr imam okkole ze hingša gori Isare hitar hatot tulidil hiyan Filate zaintode hetolla hite hen hoiyede.
Kintu ḍõr imam okkole mainšor dolore uskani diye zene Filate hitaralla Barabbasore eride.
Filate abar hitarattu fusar goijje, "Toile tũwara zare Ihudi okkolor badša hoi ḍako, tũwara ki so, ãi hitare ki goittam?"
Hitara guzori hodde, "Hitare kurušot do!"
Filate hodde, "Kiyolla, hite ki duš goijje?" Kintu hitara aro zure guzoriyore howa šuru goijje, "Hitare kurušot do!"
Filate mainšor dol okkolore razi goitto saiye. Hite hitaralla Barabbasore eridiye, kintu Isare souk maraiye edde kurušot dibolla tuli difelaiye.
Šoinno okkolor ṭaṭṭa tõša
Tarfore šoinno okkole Isare loi ḍõr šašon goroyar gõrot giye edde šoinno okkol beggunore ekkui fũwati goijje.
Hitara Isare baiyonna rongor hor findaiye, ar keṛa diyore ekkan taz banai matat findai diye.
Tarfore hitara Isare ṭaṭṭa gori hodde, "Mórhaba, Ihudi okkolor badša!"
Hitara ugguwa laṛi loi hibar mata sai bari maijje edde hibar gat sep maijje ar ãṛu felai hibare ijjot goijje.
Hibare loi ṭaṭṭa gori bade hitara he baiyonna rongor hoorgan kuli loi felaiye edde hibar nizor ho sour findai diye. Toi hitara Isare kurušot dibolla niyolai loigiyegoi.
Isare kurušot diya or
Ar Simon name ekzon Kuroni šohoror manuš farattu he fõt bai aiššil. Hite aššilde Alekzendar edde Rufusor baf. Šoinno okkole hitare Isar kuruš boi loi zaibolla zur goijje.
Hitara hibare Golgata name ekkan zagat loigiye. Ei namor mani Mata kulir zaga.
Tarfore hitara Isare tita mišaiya horor roš fito diye, kintu hibaye hin no gose.
Tarfore hitara hibare kurušot diye edde hibar horgunolla har baiggot ki hor fore hiyan saibolla hitara loṭari maijje.
Hitara hibare kurušot diyede hiya binna nowa baijje.
Hibar berudde duš nama sainbuṛot leka aššil, "IHUDI OKKOLOR BADŠA."
Hibar fũwati hitara duizon ḍahaitore o kurušot diye, ekzonore ḍen ḍakottu ar oinno ekzonore bam ḍakottu.
(Henot Pak kitabor ei hota furon oiye: "Hibare oinnai goroya okkolor fũwati gona oiye.")
Zara he fõt bai giye hitara mata zaijje edde ofoman gori hoiye, "Tui no ne dórmogórgan bangi abar tin dinor butore hiyan tiyar gori farosde!
Henoile ehon nizore basa edde kurušottu lami ai!"
Hendilla ekkui bafe ḍõr imam edde alem okkole o Isare loi ṭaṭṭa goijje edde ekzonore ekzone hodde, "Hite oinno kiyore uddar goitto, kintu nizore uddar gori no farer!
Ei Mosi, Israilor badša, ehon kurušottu lami ai ok, zene ãra sai fari edde biššaš gori fari." Hitara zarare hibar fũwati kurušot diye hitara o hibare ofoman goijje.
Bade dũijja oiye loti tin gonḍa mula ek andar hara dešor uwore foijje.
Šomoi tinnuwa baijjede šomot Isaye ḍõr abaze guzori hodde,

content: Ḍake tiyat aššilde hitarar hoekzone ei hota funiyore hodde, "Funo, hite Eliyasore ḍakedde"
Ekzone dũri zaiyore ekkan hani rošot buraiyore hiyan nolor matat gori Isare fi haito diye. Hite hodde, "Tiya! Sai, nobi Eliyase hono hitare uddar goitto aiye ne!"
Kintu Isaye zure guzoriyore šeš niyaš felaiye.
Ar dórmogóror forodagan uwottu loti nise foijjonto siri dui bag oi giyegoi.
Ze Romiyo ofisar Isar sarme tiyai aššil hite Isaye endilla gori šeš niyaš felaiyede deki hodde, "Soiyi, ei manušwa Allar Fut aššil."
Heṛe hoekzon mayafuwain o dure tiyat aššil, zara in okkol saiye. Hitarar butore aššilde, Salomi, Mogdaleni Moriyam, ar šoṛo Yakub edde Yusesor ma Moriyam.
Isa Galilor taite ei mayafuwain okkole hibar fise fise zaito edde hibar šeba gorito. Aro bout mayafuwain okkol, zara hibar fũwati uwore Zeruzalem aiššil, hitara o heṛe tiyai aššil.
Isare hobor diya or
He dinnuwa aššilde tiyarir din, mani dórmor dinor agor din, ar hazinna oi giyegoi,
Arimatiya farar Yusuf, ze ḍõr šobar beši nam gora ekzon montri, hibaye Allar raijjolla boi aššil. Hibaye himmot gori zai Isar laššuwa faibolla Filator hãse foriyad goijje.
Ar Filat tajjuf oiye ze Isa eto toratori mori giyegoi, ar šenafotire ḍaki Isa morigiyegoide oi ne, hitattu fusar goijje.
Zehon šenafotir hãsottu hite foriškar zuwab zani faijje, toi laššuwa Yusufore diye.

Yusufe zai ekkan kafonor hor kinne, toi Isar laš nise lamaiyore he hoorgan beraiyore en ek hoborot raikkegoi, ziba faharor haindat kuinda aššil. Tarfore he hoboror mukot ugguwa fattor gorgorai loizai ouzai diye.
Hibare hoṛe hobor diye, Mogdaleni Moriyam edde Yusesor ma Moriyame deikke.
